title: DispatchConfig
status_note: DISPATCH_BUILD_BLUEPRINT_v1 Part 1.1, verbatim shape. Storage mapping is approval item #1 (APPROVED 2026-08-03).

roots.description: Three logical tiers, three physical roots. 'Memory' is retired as a tier name (DISPATCH_MEMORY_AUDIT_v1's naming-collision fix, adopted).

operations.description: OPERATIONS — living system: open-period records, queues, trade memory, print queue, intake. Production: D:\Dispatch Operations.

library.description: LIBRARY — approved truth: constitutions, templates, procedures, vocabulary, rate tables, evidence index. Production: D:\Memory\Library.

archive.description: ARCHIVE — history: immutable originals, sealed bundles, report snapshots, audit rolls. Production: D:\Archive.

refusal_rule: A component MUST refuse to start if environment is 'sandbox' but any root resolves under a production path (D:\Dispatch Operations, D:\Memory, D:\Archive). No component ever hardcodes a root — all paths come from this file.
trade_memory_note: Trade Memory is per-worker working knowledge and lives under OPERATIONS (Workers\<name>\TradeMemory\), inspectable, never secret. Not a separate root.
